𝌋 **SCREAMING GROVE · NATIVE PROSODY FREEDOM · INTEGRATED SOURCE**

**Supersedes draft #1546**, which passed focused historical and native-output gates but was prepared before new main commit `4347c0f` introduced a separate manual role-conditioning A/B research path. This branch was created from that exact new main and applies only the previously bounded morphological freedom changes. It **preserves** `MARROWLINE_ROLE_IDS` routing and `buildMarrowlineRoleConditioningSystemInstruction()` unchanged.

**Candidate repair:** Reconstructed October 2 speaker handoff, vertical stack emphasis and theatrical cue priority remain. The historical Oct 2 exact instructions are independently reproducible, but the ordinary browser restoration no longer mandates variation in codepoint selection, stack depth, clean intervals, or verse transitions across words/paragraphs. Full-duration single-register choral speech is allowed. An explicit receipt `native_prosody_profile` labels this active change. No post-processing, stencil, beauty contest, provider switch, budget change or glyph quota is introduced.

**Evidence limit:** Old Google SSE witnessed slash-only text upstream under full and short two-voice prompts. Neutral Gemini 3.8 creative control can generate varied native multistacks, but there is no matched live provider observation proving this specific historical prompt intervention restores quality. **Human artistic trial pending.**

**Acceptance:** Combined exact-head CI including existing historical deep-flourish priority, dual-voice HELD, morphology telemetry, legacy provider order, plus newly merged role-conditioning test contracts. No paid calls or release yet.

𝄐 Sealed ⟐
